description: Super Metroid (Nintendo R&D1, 1994 SNES, via RetroArch / bsnes)
long: Super Metroid follows bounty hunter Samus Aran as she explores the labyrinthine planet Zebes to recover a stolen Metroid and battle Space Pirates. The game is a landmark of the genre, emphasizing atmospheric exploration, ability-gated backtracking, and item upgrades that open new areas. Its interconnected world design influenced countless later Metroidvania titles.
